problem.objective_name: negative net horizontal chassis displacement divided by full trial duration

constraints.name: fall observed (chassis ground contact or overturning)

scope: Continuous 20-second travel. Optimize net distance/time without falling. No slip, lift, requested-speed tracking, heading, steering or stopping rejection. Physical CAD, actuator and runtime model preserved. Parameter ranges are initial search windows to expand, not physical ceilings. Fall geometry is sampled; timestep and longer-distance confirmation follow promising results. Expanded the lead-factor window from 3 to 6 because the 0.448 m/s candidate was on that boundary. Requested-speed exploration also expands from 0.6 to 1.2 m/s. Two declared seeds isolate increased lead at the measured best speed/gain. These remain exploration windows, not physical limits. No observation from another context is imported as a score.
